name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage silver-gold explorer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos project on the Puna plateau of Salta province, Argentina. The project hosts a large mineral resource of 248 million ounces of silver and 2.5 million ounces of gold (454 Moz AgEq) in Measured & Indicated categories. The company is advancing toward a Definitive Feasibility Study following RIGI approval and key environmental permits received in 2026.
